column1: # How is a LoRA adapter addressed, and what is the model-routing header FOR?
# Two different questions, answered by two different things:
#   the BODY tells vLLM which adapter to apply   (vLLM never sees a header)
#   the HEADER tells the gateway which vLLM      (Gateway API cannot route on a body)
# On a service-scoped path the URL already names the service, so the header is
# unnecessary. On the SHARED endpoint the path names nothing, and the header is the
# only key that maps a model name to an InferencePool - i.e. it is an INDEX, and
# every adapter needs an entry in it. That index is what the per-adapter matches
# are, and it is why the ceiling exists.
